title: AccountRegisteredIntegrationEvent
description: Published by Auth when an account is registered; consumed by User (creates the profile) and Notification (sends the welcome e-mail). Contract source: backend/c#/OmniCore.Services.Auth/OmniCore.Services.Auth.Contracts/Events/AccountRegisteredIntegrationEvent.cs.

AccountId.description: Auth account id; the User profile id equals it (ADR 0004).

FirstName.description: Auth does not collect names: it sends the username here.
